ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake: River Works
ModMetaData.author: mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Rivers that move. Moving river water shoves pawns, corpses and loose items downstream: chest-deep water is a fast lane nobody wades out of, shallow water an edge lane you can still cross. Bigger rivers shove harder, and a spring or torrential-rain flood makes every river fiercer. Get swept to the edge of the map and you are washed away - your people walk home a few days later, and a letter tells you so. Lay ford stones across shallow water to cross safely; colonists route to fords and bridges on their own.
The works: a weir built across the bank edge stops what the river carries, calms the water for a long stretch upstream, and catches fish from the river's own stock (the same stock your fishing zones draw on) plus whatever this country's rivers bring down. A continuous line of bank stakes holds back a spring flood like a levee; any gap lets it in. Let a weir wear down and a flood breaches it: its catch washes downstream and the stake-line below it snaps post by post. Silt-traps turn the bank soil rich, and two ferry posts across a river string a rope nobody is swept off.
Every piece has a toggle in Mod Settings.
